lessons.title: Learning for Life
lessons.goal: Talk and write about how people learn, using the present perfect and past simple correctly.

lessons.title: Work and Careers
lessons.goal: Understand talks about jobs, describe a bar chart and compare data with comparatives and superlatives.

lessons.title: Our Changing Planet
lessons.goal: Follow a discussion about an environmental project and explain causes, effects and solutions in writing.

lessons.title: Living with Technology
lessons.goal: Follow a short lecture, write a full advantages and disadvantages essay and add detail with relative clauses.

lessons.title: Health and Lifestyle
lessons.goal: Talk and write about healthy habits with precise collocations, and give advice with should, ought to, have to and need to.

lessons.title: Cities and Housing
lessons.goal: Describe how a place has changed, in speech and in a Task 1 map report, using the passive and precise words for cities and housing.

lessons.title: Travel and Tourism
lessons.goal: Discuss the benefits and costs of tourism, follow a three-person discussion, and speculate with first and second conditionals.

lessons.title: Media and Advertising
lessons.goal: Follow a short lecture and an academic text on advertising, and write a careful opinion essay using hedging language.

lessons.title: Family and Relationships
lessons.goal: Follow conversations and texts about family life, and describe past habits naturally with used to and would.

lessons.title: Food and Farming
lessons.goal: Follow a talk on a working farm, describe a pie chart, and use countable and uncountable nouns with the right quantifiers.

lessons.title: Crime and the Law
lessons.goal: Follow a discussion and a text about punishment and crime prevention, and report other people's views with reported speech.

lessons.title: Science and Research
lessons.goal: Follow a short lecture on how science checks itself, describe a table of figures, and choose correctly between -ing and to-infinitive after verbs.

lessons.title: Art and Culture
lessons.goal: Understand bookings and opinions about the arts, describe things vividly with the right adjective order and intensifiers, and write a full discussion essay.

lessons.title: Sport and Fitness
lessons.goal: Follow a talk about a new sports centre and a text on whether watching sport makes people active, and make careful predictions with will, be going to and be likely to.

lessons.title: Space Exploration
lessons.goal: Follow a tutorial discussion and an academic text about space, talk about ongoing activities with the present perfect continuous, and answer a two-part essay question.

lessons.title: Language and Communication
lessons.goal: Follow a lecture on endangered languages and a text on age and language learning, and write a formal opinion essay using nominalisation for an academic style.

lessons.title: A Connected World
lessons.goal: Follow a discussion about a company's supply chain, weigh the gains and losses of globalisation in an essay, and link ideas with participle clauses.

lessons.title: Living Longer
lessons.goal: Understand a talk about a home-sharing scheme, weigh the effects of an ageing population in an essay, and use third and mixed conditionals to talk about the past.

lessons.title: Every Drop Counts
lessons.goal: Take notes on a lecture about groundwater, explain causes of and solutions to water scarcity in an essay, and contrast ideas with although, despite, whereas and while.

lessons.title: Built to Last
lessons.goal: Book a guided walk and catch details on the phone, argue whether new buildings should match old ones, and report beliefs and claims with It is said that… and X is thought to…

lessons.title: Wild Neighbours
lessons.goal: Follow a lecture on bringing lost species back, describe a natural life cycle in a Task 1 process report, and use defining and non-defining relative clauses with the right punctuation.

lessons.title: Buying Happiness?
lessons.goal: Catch details in a call about a repair service, discuss why people buy so much in a two-part essay, and pack information into complex noun phrases.

lessons.title: Growing Up
lessons.goal: Follow students discussing a study of parents and children, discuss strict and relaxed parenting in an essay, and make deductions about the present and past with must, might and can't (have).

lessons.title: Getting Around
lessons.goal: Understand a talk about changes to a city's transport, describe a line graph with two lines, and report trends precisely with verbs and adverbs such as rose sharply and levelled off.

lessons.title: Living with Natural Hazards
lessons.goal: Understand talks and texts about disasters and adaptation, and explain causes and results with nouns such as the main cause of, led to and resulted in.

lessons.title: Universities Today
lessons.goal: Follow a tutorial and an academic text about higher education, and emphasise your main point with cleft sentences (What matters is…, It is … that…).

lessons.title: Social Media and Well-being
lessons.goal: Understand opinions about social media and mental health, and adjust how strongly you state a view with arguably, undoubtedly and to some extent.

lessons.title: The Future of Energy
lessons.goal: Follow a lecture on renewable energy, describe a table of energy data, and add emphasis with inversion after Not only, Rarely and Only recently.

lessons.title: Museums and the Past
lessons.goal: Understand a guided talk and a text about museums, describe changes on a map, and link ideas across sentences with this trend, such measures and the former/the latter.

lessons.title: Automation and Work
lessons.goal: Follow a student discussion and an article about automation, weigh advantages and disadvantages, and contrast ideas across sentences with By contrast, Conversely and On the other hand.

lessons.title: Medicine and Public Health
lessons.goal: Follow a lecture and an article about public health, answer a two-part essay question, and support ideas with examples using for instance, a case in point is and notably.

lessons.title: City or Country?
lessons.goal: Understand a rental enquiry and an article about leaving the city, discuss two views in an essay, and end with a clear conclusion and recommendation.

lessons.title: The Ethics of Technology
lessons.goal: Follow a full-length lecture and a writer's argument on technology ethics, and make claims with careful caveats (while it is true that…, this is not to say…).

lessons.title: Migration and Multicultural Societies
lessons.goal: Follow a tutorial discussion and an academic text on migration, and paraphrase ideas accurately with synonyms, changes of word class and changes of structure.

lessons.title: Biodiversity and Conservation Policy
lessons.goal: Follow a site talk and an academic text on conservation policy, and build complex sentences with embedded clauses (what…, whether…, the fact that…).

lessons.title: Government and Public Spending
lessons.goal: Follow a detailed enquiry and an academic text on public spending, report a bar chart and a pie chart together, and evaluate arguments with counter-arguments (It could be argued…, However, this overlooks…).

lessons.title: Psychology and Decision-Making
lessons.goal: Follow a lecture and an academic text on how people make choices, and write with precise academic collocations (pose a threat, draw a conclusion, play a role).

lessons.title: Innovation and Entrepreneurship
lessons.goal: Follow a student discussion and an academic text on start-ups and innovation, and connect ideas without overusing linkers (lexical chains, substitution, ellipsis).

lessons.title: Food Security
lessons.goal: Follow a guided tour and an argument about feeding a growing population, describe a process in a Task 1 report, and check articles and prepositions in academic writing.

lessons.title: The Future of Work and Society
lessons.goal: Follow a seminar planning discussion and an academic text on automation and work, use idiomatic language naturally in Speaking, and know when to keep it out of Writing.
